solutionSteps: Restart the router and wait 2 minutes.
Turn off router power for 30 seconds and turn it on again.
Place the router in an open area.
Reduce connected devices if too many users are connected.
nextIfNotSolved: Run a speed test near the router and contact Excel support with the result.
escalationMessage: If speed remains low after these steps, contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point.

solutionSteps: Move the router to an open place.
Change WiFi channel if the router supports it.
nextIfNotSolved: Check if the same problem happens beside the router. If yes, service inspection may be needed.
escalationMessage: If WiFi still disconnects, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Check if the WAN cable is connected properly.
Confirm that the internet bill or ISP line is active.
Check if the internet light is stable.
nextIfNotSolved: If LOS/red light continues, contact your ISP or Excel support point.
escalationMessage: If internet is still not working, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Check the exact router model and hardware version.
Download firmware only from the official brand website.
Do not turn off power during update.
nextIfNotSolved: If you are unsure about model or hardware version, do not update manually.
escalationMessage: Contact Excel support before firmware update if you are unsure.

solutionSteps: Set a new WiFi password and save.
Reconnect devices using the new password.
nextIfNotSolved: If admin login is unknown, router reset and reconfiguration may be required.
escalationMessage: Contact Excel support if password reset fails.

solutionSteps: Check camera power adapter or PoE power.
Test one camera directly if possible.
nextIfNotSolved: The camera, cable, or power adapter may need physical inspection.
escalationMessage: If camera remains offline, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Check monitor power and input source.
Check DVR display resolution if possible.
nextIfNotSolved: DVR output port or monitor may need inspection.
escalationMessage: If display is still blank, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Check PoE power and LAN cable.
Confirm cameras are on the same network.
Add the camera again if needed.
nextIfNotSolved: Camera IP planning may need engineer support.
escalationMessage: If cameras still do not show, contact Excel support.

nextIfNotSolved: Driver or printer hardware may need inspection.
escalationMessage: If printer still does not print, contact Excel support.

nextIfNotSolved: Roller or sensor cleaning may be needed.
escalationMessage: If paper jam repeats, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Test backup again with safe load.
nextIfNotSolved: Battery health test or replacement may be needed.
escalationMessage: Contact Excel support for battery testing.

nextIfNotSolved: Connected load may exceed UPS capacity.
escalationMessage: If overload continues, contact Excel support.

solutionSteps: Keep the product serial number ready.
Contact nearest Excel support point for warranty record check.
Do not open warranty product outside authorized service.
nextIfNotSolved: Visit a CSP with product, invoice, and serial number.
escalationMessage: For warranty verification, contact Excel Customer Support Point.

solutionSteps: Share your phone number if you want sales follow-up.
Contact your nearest Excel sales point for stock and price.
nextIfNotSolved: Excel sales team can guide based on location.
escalationMessage: For sales support, contact your nearest Excel sales point.
